mika: Heads-up — onboarding Crownstone13b from HF. Quick sanity check: int4 conversion + kvcache longctx shows positional phase drift and an odd vocab sentinel mapping. anyone around?
sumi: seen the bench flake earlier, thought it was just noise. do you have a small repro?
raj: can you attach the convert command + tokenizer info? suspicious shift often comes from token index mismatch.
mika: convert cmd used: `python convert.py --model crownstone13b --quant int4 --scheme aqt --out /tmp/crownstone-q4`
logs snippet: ```
INFO Converted layers 0..40
WARN tokenizer.vocab_size=50257 (expected 50256)
WARN sentinel id 50256 remapped -> 50257
```
laura: that remap is the red flag. sounds like there was an extra sentinel token in the source tokenizer (soft/eos overlap). did you check tokenizer.json or merges?
mika: tokenizer.json: `{"vocab_size": 50257, "model_max_length": 8192}`. original HF card says 50256. sample failing prompt: "Hello-world" (contains invisible chars). tokenization differs after conversion.
sumi: on the longctx tests we saw a 0.6-0.8% PPL regression for int4 default vs fp16 on dialogue rolls, and attention alignment plots show phase drift near head 5..8. might be rotary scale mismatch.
raj: two angles: tokenizer shift causes different tokens so kv cache alignment looks wrong; OR rotary parameters (headwise vs shared) were collapsed in conversion. which rotary implementation does Crownstone use?
mika: Crownstone uses per-head rotary scaling (headwise_scale true). our converter defaulted to shared-scale for compact kernels.
laura: ah — we have a converter flag `--headwise-rotary-scale` but it's off by default because it increases kernel code paths. try re-converting with that. also check `--preserve-eos` for token mapping.
mika: repro run: `python convert.py --model crownstone13b --quant int4 --scheme aqt --headwise-rotary-scale --preserve-eos`
quick bench (small sample):
```
baseline fp16 perplexity: 12.3
int4 default: 13.9
int4 headwise-rotary: 12.4
```
raj: that's promising — headwise rotary recovered most of the quality. what's left is the tokenizer mismap. we need a token_map audit.
sumi: I ran `tools/token_map --model /tmp/crownstone-q4 --check-sentinels` and got: `50256 -> 50257 (collision with <soft-hyphen U+00AD>)`. There is a zero-width joiner + soft-hyphen mixture in a few tests.
laura: plan: add fuzz tests for ZWJ, soft-hyphen, zero-width no-break space combos in tokenizer tests. also add a CI gate on conversion that verifies `token_map --roundtrip` passes.
mika: opened PR #4123 with converter flags, CI job, and a tiny fuzzy corpus (10k cases) under tests/tokenizer_edgecases. Added notes in PR description about headwise rotary.
raj: benchmark job queued by deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: enqueued bench run 9951234570 for PR #4123, status: queued.
sumi: after bench finishes let's run the longctx kvcache alignment plot across 8 seeds to be safe. we saw non-deterministic head-level noise previously.
laura: I'll add metadata recording in the model card: `original_vocab_size`, `conversion_flags`, `tokenizer_fingerprint` to avoid mystery remaps later.
mika: TG — thanks for triage. next steps: merge PR after bench pass, add token_map CI, and update model metadata. @laura please own the tokenizer fuzz test PR followup?
laura: Yep will own it. adding checklist to PR. :thumbsup:
raj: one more note — add a short doc under docs/model_onboard.md describing common pitfalls: vocab off-by-one, headwise vs shared rotary, preserve-eos flag. helps solutions engineers.
mika: done, added a short section and linked PR.
sumi: thanks team. if bench shows anything else, ping #eng-ml with the results.
mika: thanks all :thumbsup:
